name: Unidirectional transmittance-based path sampling
definition: A method to construct paths by incrementally adding vertices from one endpoint (light or eye) until a light source or sensor is hit, sampling propagation distance proportional to transmittance.
summary: Unidirectional transmittance-based path sampling, or light tracing, constructs paths from a single endpoint by sampling distances proportional to transmittance, distinguishing itself by building from the light source rather than the eye.
